notes.title: MIRO Content Update: 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!


It's been an incredible journey so far, and seeing your reactions and how each of you approached the game has been even better than what I was expecting. MIRO is a passion project, developed barely by three people and I'm really happy with the reception. People enjoying the game is the most important thing to us.



And while I was fixing all bugs and issues you guys reported, I was also working on some other things totally in secret.

So, let's get to the point of this post: content added in version 1.1



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/274f1ee0c0286ee5c438f49409a9b64354e7f41d.png"]

This update adds a lot more procedural assets to the pool, you'll notice that the flora has been upgraded with new tree models, leaves, and bushes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/9700c2ea8ff0ca27d041a72106ec9bc89e4e6f8b.png"]

Some trees can get really weird. But that's part of exploring, right? Uncovering the unknown!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/c7e655b615b315521fe4f571445aef75d63318bf.png"]

You'll also find some new abandoned structures on planets, some with even deadlier hazards than before, but always with something worthwhile inside.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/d2d038bdee7a6e7c0f369861cd0ff2cd15421158.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/a2e58de58a3aee8ea4610fbb93aa7986b5601cb7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/2d95221e7e181e9f7b578756bbe03851025555e2.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/33e6359f9cd04a4b212df5a49a17cbc0d5eda4d4.png"]

Some of these structures will also give some more insight of the universe that MIRO takes place on. Most of these new structures are only available from Gamma cluster and onward, so make sure you are well equipped to explore these!





And of course, there was a lot of other fixes and changes that should make the moment to moment more engaging. Here's a quick list of fixes:

Fixed creature behavior when hunting the player.

Fixed creature procedural animations.

Adjusted creature spawn rules.

Adjusted creature texture creation process.

Fixed Auto travel menu.

Adjusted spawn rate of tier 3 taser.

Cloud coverage adjustments per cluster.

Better weather transitions and sounds.

Performance adjustments (especially for the Steam Deck).

Fixed procedural clutter generation.

Adjusted render distance.

Adjusted fog rendering.

Added more grass types.

Fixed building position.

Added tutorial computer.

Adjusted hover bike physics.

Added hover bike location on map.

Changed terminal colors on MIRO's hub.

Planet where you dropped your loot is now marked on the terminal.

As always, have fun and please let me know if you run into any issues.





And lastly, but also important, all your feedback is appreciated, let me know what you like and don't like about the game. 

And if you like it, let your friends know! This is a REAL independent project, any visibility helps us a lot.





I hope you have an overall great day.

See you soon, enjoy!



Glauber "Trevis" Bonifácio

notes.title: MIRO - Beta branch and update rate
notes.notes:
Hi!

First of all, thanks for all the support. 
Developing a game for PC is quite hard on its own, there are infinite possible hardware combinations and MIRO is a huge game. During these last weeks, I've been hard at work fixing any bugs you guys have found.

Deploying these fixes daily is nice, but it's also dangerous, as any fix might break other things. This is how I ended up destroying the continue button. And the language selector. And other million minor things.
I don't plan on stopping these daily updates, but I'll change how I provide them to you.

That's why I've created the BETA branch here on Steam.

You can opt in by going into Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation. There's no password, so just change it and let Steam download the update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/a1594271b97e1015d6157073893d3e2c76168b05.png

I'll probably update the main branch once a week, after testing the beta build for a little longer (or when a MAJOR issue is found on the main branch).

I believe this new flow will make sure the game is more stable overall.

As always, I'm open to suggestions. Let me know what you think!

Thanks and have fun :)

notes.title: MIRO 1.0.5 - Small changes and AMD workaround
notes.notes:
Hello!

During last week, thanks to the feedback of some players, we've found an issue affecting some people using AMD cards. Mainly issue was a black screen during gameplay.

I have not yet been able to really fix this issue, but we've managed to implement a workaround.

If you experiencie a black screen, try changing the "Disable Extra Color Tilt" option under video settings. This will remove some post effects from the game, but it solved the issue for the players that reported it.

I'll keep working on this, I hope to find a real fix soon.

This build also has some small fixes:
- Added color indicator to warehouse locked door
- Adjusted some possible terrain issues
- Increased shader performance on Steam Deck
- Better stability when loading planet saves


Let me know if you run into any other issues

Thanks!

notes.title: MIRO: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello, to all three of you!

We've pushed a small hotfix for MIRO:

- Fixed issue with save system when loading keycards
- Fixed Creatures poking their heads into stones and walls
- Fixed terrain blocking doors on incubators
- Possible fix for wrong references when starting a new game

These fixes are available both in the full and demo version.

Thanks for all the feedback
Let us know if you run into any issues!

notes.title: MIRO Demo: Update 0.1.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've been working tirelessly to finish MIRO's main missions and content. These things also affect the current demo version, so we've updated our current version with a bunch of fixes and functionality!

Here's a quick overview:

- Player can now crouch, making less noise
- Creatures interact better with each other, carnivores of different species can now fight each other and some herbivores will defend themselves.
- Balanced planet progression: we've removed some bloat and made the initial planets more interesting by increasing the number and types of buildings that can be found on them
- A lot of other fixes that I honestly don't remember right now :( 


Let us know if you run into any issues or have any feedback!

Enjoy your travels :)

notes.title: MIRO playtest version 0.1.26 released!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear collaborators, we hope this message finds you well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/a1594271b97e1015d6157073893d3e2c76168b05.png

We have deployed a new version of MIRO's playtest. It should be available by the time I finish writing up these patch notes.
Here's a quick overview of the major changes you'll find in this update:

- Save clouds
- Multiple save slots
- New building type: Warehouses
- New enemy: Eletrobot (temporary name, we're open to suggestions)
- New minor POI: Drone patrol
- Procedural Planet names
- Better fall damage calculation
- Improved creature behavior
- Visual and post effects adjustments
- Grass rendering improvements
- Performance adjustments
- UI improvements
- Terrain adjustments
- FOV option added to settings


We thank you for your feedback during these last weeks, it's been extremely helpful in our journey.
We hope you enjoy and, please, let us know if you find any issues.

See you soon!
